capacity_gross_kwh.notes: "16 kWh" total capacity, 88 cells (2016 press kit); Mitsubishi Canada history page: 16-kWh pack. Same pack 2012-2017 (LEV50 cells, LEV50N from 2013 at the same capacity per Wikipedia).

chemistry.notes: INL 2012 fact sheet: "Lithium-Ion (LMO)"; cathode lithium-manganese dioxide, so the enum value is other. Specs there are manufacturer-supplied, measured or derived. 2012 car; LEV50N cells from 2013 are assumed the same chemistry.

nominal_voltage_class.notes: 330 V nominal (2016 press kit; Guide Auto Canada 330 V); mapped to the 400v class (the schema has no lower class).

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: The 2016 press kit lists a battery heater for cold-weather charging and remote cabin pre-conditioning (cabin only); no navigation- or charger-linked battery warming for DC charging. The heater runs automatically while plugged in, so this is a judgement call. Compared 2012 (optional Cold Zone package) with 2016-2017 (standard).

ac_max_kw.notes: Wikipedia infobox: 15 A 240 V AC (3.6 kW) on SAE J1772; other sources say 3.3 kW (not opened).

dc_max_kw.notes: Fastned: i-MiEV (2011-2018) max charge speed 40 kW, CHAdeMO; Mitsubishi says 80% in under 30 minutes.
